details: Industrial Modbus RTU RS-485 Engine verified cleanly (9/9 stages passed).

data.gate: Gate G8 Industrial Protocols / Gate G4 Scan Cycle Simulation
data.component: Industrial Modbus RTU Over RS-485 Half-Duplex Turnaround & Inter-Frame Silent Interval Engine

tests.details: Parsed ModbusRtuRs485Sync and alias with 10 registered bindings: ['%M303', '%M304', '%R1300', '%R1301', '%R1302', '%R1303', '%R1304', '%R1305', '%R1306', '%R1307'].
Deterministic 11-bit character timing, t1.5, and t3.5 calculations verified across all standard baud rates.
Serialization, little-endian CRC-16 (0xA001/0xFFFF), and deserialization verified.
RTS/DE/~RE transceiver transitions and 500 us turnaround delay verified.
IDLE -> TRANSMIT -> TURNAROUND -> SILENT_INTERVAL_T35 -> IDLE state cycle verified.
Premature transmission before 3.5 character silence trapped deterministically with 0xC201.
Driver enable during turnaround line settling trapped deterministically with 0xC202.
Corrupted CRC (0xC203) and t1.5 character overrun (0xC204) trapped deterministically.
ILogicUnit scan execution, manual operator reset handshake, and full memory synchronization verified.
